verdict.rationale: Fireworks advertises an OpenAI-compatible API and 'drop-in replacement' for inference (docs-1, docs-15, docs-36), which implies support for standard OpenAI features like streaming, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of SSE, `stream: true`, or token-by-token completion behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of streaming/SSE endpoints, code examples showing incremental token delivery, and independent confirmation of low time-to-first-token streaming.
